acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Djinn family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Wish-Sultan, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Lamp-Court Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Palace-scale Wish-Sultan with a lower-body vortex, floating throne, constellation of bound lamps, and robes woven from smoke and gold.

Signature mechanic: Arena Command — Four Bound Lamps: one lamp orbits to the throne front, its smoke robe forms a lower Djinn posture, and the vortex closes a corresponding court lane until that form's learned anchor is solved.
battlefieldDuty: Command a palace-scale vortex arena where four bound lamps stage learned lower-form clauses around a floating throne.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 vapor, half-face, and trailing plume gain an invisible pressure loop; T2 the defined torso and plain cuffs gain reflective valves; T3 visible wind arms and orbiting rings gain coherent conduits; T4 crown and sacred script gain fill glyphs; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps gain bounded cistern tethers.

Motion/process branches: T1 the vapor half-face fills and drains its plume loop; T2 the torso vents mist through one cuff valve; T3 the wind arms alternate orbiting-ring conduit flow; T4 crown script fills and empties one glyph; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps pressurize and drain one tethered cistern.
counterplay: Answer the announced lower-form lesson and sever the exposed lamp tether; each freed lamp opens a court lane and removes one vortex command. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 pressure loss opens the vapor half-face plume loop; T2 the torso cuff exposes its valve after drainage; T3 wind arms and orbiting rings expose the empty conduit between releases; T4 crown script exposes the drained fill glyph between clauses; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps expose the cistern tether after pressure loss.
forbiddenTreatments: Mist that hides the binding anchor
identityInvariants: A hovering humanoid upper body tapers into smoke instead of legs; solidity and scale change only at explicit tiers.
Sapphire or violet smoke, warm inner light, gold, brass, turquoise, silk, and gemstones remain distinct source materials.
Cuffs, rings, headpieces, lamps, and script mark proposed binding status without establishing universal culture or morality.
The body becomes less solid and more spatially dominant from half-face vapor to a palace-scale throne vortex.
telegraph: The floating throne turns, one lamp descends on a visible gold tether, and the smoke robes adopt a familiar half-face, cuff, ring, or script silhouette.
